disclosureQuote: Dynasty and RTG Modes - Storyline content in hub screen, Design Implementation and tuning Commentary scripting support Trophy Room Support Creating more realistic play calls made by CPU teams
summary: 美式大学橄榄球模拟。开发者在 Dynasty 与 Road to Glory 模式下列出 AI 参与的环节：大厅界面剧情内容、设计实现与调参、解说脚本支持、奖杯室支持，以及让 CPU 球队做出更真实的战术呼叫；未逐项说明其他领域。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Tiburon）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 286），首页没有与 AI 披露直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 3 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（HowMuchAI 的游玩时生成内容清单，其中对本作的摘要与商店披露一致）；ResetEra 与 Facebook 的讨论帖需登录或拦截抓取，未能读取。披露是按环节而非按领域撰写的，凡未点名的领域一律按未说明处理。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
description: 官方披露按使用环节列出 AI，集中在剧情、解说脚本与 CPU 战术，未逐领域说明。

english.summary: A college football simulation. The developer lists AI involvement in Dynasty and Road to Glory modes as storyline content on the hub screen, design implementation and tuning, commentary scripting support, trophy room support and more realistic play calls by CPU teams, without addressing the remaining areas.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Tiburon) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 286); no homepage topic directly concerns the disclosure and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched once with 3 results logged and one raw source read (the HowMuchAI live-generation list, whose summary of this title matches the store disclosure); ResetEra and Facebook threads need a login or block automated fetching and could not be read. The disclosure is written by workflow rather than by area, so every area it does not name is recorded as not stated. Findings rely on developer statements, not an independent audit.
